purpose: Correct independent ground-state reference coverage before any reference has been generated or inspected
supersedes: The determinant-only reference starting vector in tensor_bh_accuracy_protocol_20261117.json; all prediction settings and reference capacity/stopping thresholds remain unchanged
starting_vector: Equal-norm sum of the independent closed-shell determinant and one fixed generic CUDA random vector projected into the complete singlet space; normalize once. The generic component is not restricted to the determinant's extra spatial symmetries.
reason: A determinant-only Krylov start may remain in one spatial-symmetry sector and miss a lower singlet in a different sector. The independent reference must cover the full intended spin space.
